blocks.text: Klarisse de Guzman is mourning the death of her mother, Esnobie de Guzman, whom she publicly credited for supporting and accepting her identity. The “Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition” Season 1 alum announced her mother’s passing in an Instagram post on Saturday, Oct. 24, sharing a photo of herself wearing a laboratory gown with her head bowed down in an apparent hospital bed. “Mahal na mahal kita, Mama ko. Iyakap mo na lang ako kay Papa ah. Mahal na mahal ko kayo,” she wrote. The cause of death was not immediately known. In the comments section, celebrity friends Shuvee Etrata, […]...
